Lemma
[Gauss Lemma] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0300 1. Lemma B.1\group local-comparison-geometry

Let $(\mathcal M^n,g)$ be a complete Riemannian manifold, let $p\in \mathcal M^n$, and let $V,W\in T_p\mathcal M^n$ satisfy $\langle V,W\rangle =0$. Then along the geodesic ray determined by $V$, the differential of the exponential map preserves orthogonality to the radial direction: \[ \langle (\exp _p)_*(V_{tV}),(\exp _p)_*(W_{tV})\rangle = 0. \]

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0300 \sketch This is the standard Gauss lemma for the exponential map.

□
